Today, the name may evoke images of keeping score or maintaining an accurate record of something. It can also be seen as a nod to the importance of record-keeping in legal and administrative contexts.

It is a reminder of the importance of keeping the commandments of God and maintaining a good relationship with Him. Just as a tally marks the number of things that have been counted, our spiritual lives are also a record of our obedience and faithfulness to God. The name Tally serves as a call to strive for faithfulness and to keep God's commandments in all aspects of our lives.
